app.name: Trade management
app.tagline: Stock, sales and customer credit for wholesalers

auth.loginDescription: Enter the email and password of your account.
auth.registerDescription: You will own the account. You can add your employees afterwards.
auth.companyNameHint: As it will appear on your delivery notes and invoices. You can change it in Settings.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Your catalog: units, barcodes and prices per level.
products.emptyDescription: Add your first product or change the search.
products.generalHelp: What identifies the product on delivery notes and invoices.
products.baseUnitHint: Stock is counted in this unit. It cannot change after creation.
products.tvaIgnored: Your company is not subject to VAT: this rate is not applied.
products.minStockHint: An alert shows below this level (in base unit).
products.activeHint: An inactive product stays in history but is no longer offered for sale.
products.unitsHelp: Add the packagings (carton, bundle…) with how many base units they hold.
products.defaultSaleHint: Unit offered by default when selling
products.defaultPurchaseHint: Unit offered by default when buying
products.pricesHelp: One price per unit and level. Leave empty if the unit is not sold at that level.
products.costPending: The weighted average cost will show here after the first purchases or opening stock.
products.archiveBody: It leaves search and sales but stays in history. You can restore it.

rules.base_unit_missing: The base unit must be in the list of units.
rules.duplicate_unit: This unit is already in the list.
rules.exactly_one_default_sale: Choose exactly one default sale unit.
rules.exactly_one_default_purchase: Choose exactly one default purchase unit.
rules.whole_factor_required: This product is counted by the piece: the content must be a whole number.
rules.whole_min_stock_required: This product is counted by the piece: the minimum stock must be a whole number.
rules.base_unit_immutable: The base unit cannot be changed.

categories.title: Categories
categories.subtitle: Organize your products. A category can have subcategories.
categories.name: Name
categories.deleteBody: It must be empty (no products and no subcategories).
categories.emptyDescription: Create categories to find your products faster.

priceLevels.title: Price levels
priceLevels.help: Names shown in the price grid and on the sale screen.
priceLevels.name: Level {position}

stock.title: Stock
stock.subtitle: Quantities, weighted average cost and value of your stock.
stock.emptyDescription: Add products to track their stock.
stock.cardSubtitle: Every entry and exit, with the balance after each movement.
stock.adjustHelp: For breakage, loss or a typing mistake. An entry is valued at the current average cost.
stock.negativeWarning: Warning: this product's stock is now negative ({after}).
stock.openingHelp: The quantity on hand when you start and its purchase cost. Entered once; afterwards use an adjustment.

inventory.listSubtitle: Count the real stock; validating only fixes the differences.
inventory.emptyDescription: Create a stock count to check your stock.
inventory.scanHint: Scan an item, type the counted quantity, press Enter to go back to scanning.
inventory.validateBody: Stock will be corrected for each difference, at the current average cost. A validated count can no longer change.
inventory.cancelBody: The count is dropped and stock does not change.

productCost.none: No stock recorded yet. Enter the opening stock from the Stock page.

purchases.title: Purchases
purchases.subtitle: Goods receipts: what you receive from your suppliers.
purchases.emptyDescription: Enter your first receipt when goods arrive.
purchases.scanPlaceholder: Scan or type a reference, then Enter
purchases.scanHint: After scanning: quantity, Enter, cost, Enter.
purchases.noLines: No items. Scan or type a reference above.
purchases.tvaOff: You are not subject to VAT: the VAT paid to the supplier is added to the purchase cost (average cost).
purchases.validateBody: Stock and average cost will be updated. A validated receipt can no longer change: only a return or a cancellation is possible.
purchases.updatePricesHint: Only change the prices you want to change. The others stay the same.
purchases.cancelBodyValidated: The quantities still in stock will be removed. The average cost does not change.
purchases.returnHelp: Quantity to send back for each item (at most what is left).

suppliers.title: Suppliers
suppliers.subtitle: The suppliers on your goods receipts.

suppliers.emptyDescription: Add your suppliers to enter goods receipts.
